title: You, Me, and the Sea Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: You, Me, and the Sea, Seaside, Fl! Just out of an amazing renovation. Two king primary suites, bunk room, two porches & a covered open-air tower with the most amazing gulf views & sunsets over Seaside, Florida!
description_expanded: Description91 TUPELO STREET2 KINGS, 2 TWIN BUNKS, 2 QUEEN SLEEPERS SOFAS- Sleeps 12!Welcome to You, Me, and the SeaLocated on iconic Tupelo Street in the heart of Seaside, Florida, You, Me, and the Sea is a beautifully renovated coastal cottage that has quickly become a guest favorite. With its fresh white exterior, shaded fenced front yard, and classic front porch featuring rocking chairs and an outdoor swing, this home offers a quintessential Seaside welcome from the moment you arrive.Main Living & KitchenStep inside to a comfortable living space with plush seating and a mounted flat-screen TV, perfect for unwinding after a day at the beach. A short set of stairs leads to the open-concept main living level, where the living, dining, and kitchen spaces flow seamlessly together and showcase designer furnishings and thoughtful details throughout.The dining area features built-in seating surrounding a stone tulip table that comfortably seats six to eight guests. Adjacent is a wet bar complete with a beverage refrigerator and ice maker, ideal for entertaining. The chef-style kitchen is fully equipped with high-end appliances, including a six-burner gas range, Sub-Zero refrigerator, farmhouse sink, generous counter space, and a pantry—making family meals and gatherings effortless.Bedrooms & BathroomsThe second level is home to all sleeping accommodations. The king primary suite includes a sitting area with a sofa and chair, dresser storage, a mounted flat-screen TV, and access to a private balcony with lounge seating overlooking the Tupelo Gazebo. Just down the hall, the second king bedroom offers its own flat-screen TV, dresser storage, and a private en-suite bathroom.The third bedroom is a charming bunk room featuring four twin beds, dresser storage, and a mounted flat-screen TV. A nearby full bathroom with a spacious walk-in shower serves this bedroom.Private Tower & ViewsA staircase leads to the home’s private open-air tower—an unforgettable Seaside feature. This elevated retreat includes seating for two and offers panoramic views of Seaside and the Gulf of Mexico, making it the perfect spot to enjoy morning coffee, sunset views, or a quiet moment above town.The Seaside ExperienceWhether you’re planning a relaxing beach escape or a memorable family getaway, You, Me, and the Sea offers timeless Seaside charm, modern luxury, and an unbeatable location just steps from all that Seaside, Florida has to offer.*5-night minimum Spring Break, Spring, & Summer; Fall 3 night minimum, winter 2 night minimum. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES1,778 square feet176 yards or a 2-minute walk to beach accessPrivate Seaside Residential Beach at Tupelo Pavilion — the largest private residential beach on 30AAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking information: Two parking passes are issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a vehicle. Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR24-001373
